checkpoint_review: The Router was appropriately strict. It correctly identified that while the general color matches 'sorrel', almost every structural checkpoint failed. The head, neck, body proportions, mane/tail, and limbs were all marked as not present due to severe distortion and fusion. I agree with all verdicts. The only 'present' checkpoint was coat color, which is a superficial feature compared to the catastrophic anatomical failures.
artifact_review: The Router's severity ratings are accurate and perhaps even conservative regarding the limb collapse (Severity 5.0). The fusion between rider and horse (Severity 4.5) is visually undeniable. The text gibberish (Severity 3.0) is a clear AI artifact. The topology mask confirms the 'rider-horse complex' is treated as a single fused blob by segmentation models, supporting the fusion observation. The pose auditor's high rate of low-confidence keypoints (44%) strongly corroborates the structural collapse in the limbs and face.
alignment_reasoning: Only 1 out of 8 checkpoints passed (coat color). The subject is semantically recognizable as a horse/rider pair (confirmed by fine_grained_classifier top-1 'sorrel'), but structurally it fails to meet the taxonomic definition of a sorrel due to melted anatomy, missing hooves, and fused limbs. The alignment is extremely low because the biological structure is fundamentally broken.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic structural artifacts dominate the image. Legs merge into the ground and each other (Severity 5). Rider fuses with the horse (Severity 4.5). Text is gibberish (Severity 3). Background perspective is warped (Severity 2.5). The image exhibits classic diffusion model failures where boundaries and rigid structures collapse. The score is near the bottom of the scale, comparable to or worse than the 'low' reference hammerhead which had structural issues but less total meltdown.
key_defects: Catastrophic limb collapse: Hooves are missing blobs, legs fuse together and into the ground.
Severe fusion: Rider's torso and green jacket merge indistinguishably with the horse's neck and shoulder.
Structural distortion: Head and neck lack defined anatomy, appearing as a smudged mass.
Text gibberish: Illegible nonsensical characters at the bottom.
Background warping: Fence rails bend unnaturally.
